rationale: Because John Roberts is both in the majority and has articulated the narrow, precedent-respecting path (rejecting a categorical pecuniary-loss prerequisite while tightening Liu guardrails), he is most likely to keep the assignment and write for the Court. The three dissenters are likely to fragment between an originalist/equity-history dissent (Thomas or Gorsuch) and a penalty/separation-of-powers dissent (Jackson), while one or more majority Justices may add a concurrence emphasizing anti-penalty limits and distribution-to-investors findings.
